changelog:
spraay-gateway 1.0.1

- Removed skill-card.md file.
- SKILL.md updated with an explicit section on permissions and network access, clarifying HTTPS, filesystem, and credential usage.
- No changes to API endpoints, unlock flows, or core usage. 
- All other functionality and requirements remain unchanged.
summary: Batch stablecoin payments — up to 200 recipients per transaction, ~80% gas savings — plus escrow, payroll, and robot task payments via the Spraay x402 gateway (190 endpoints, 15 chains). Free endpoints need no account; paid access via $29/mo card subscription or x402 pay-per-call USDC.
